_comment: #464 regression fixture AND a real palette. `neighborhood` is the slashed geojson `nhood`
string verbatim - that is the key BuildingAssembler.ResolvePalette compares against the fact
the bake copied out of python/data/sf_analysis_neighborhoods.geojson. Only the GENERATED
asset's file name is sanitised, by AssetFileName.Encode, to Generated/Palettes/
This source file's own name is arbitrary - BuildingTemplateLibraryImporter globs *.palette.json
and reads `neighborhood` from inside - but it is spelt the way server/app/export.py's _safe()
would spell it, so a later POST /export/unity overwrites this file instead of adding a second
Colours: the Doelger tract stucco of the outer Sunset - pastel fields with a white-ish trim
and a darker garage-door/metal note. Not verified in the Editor (no Unity available); they are
authored values, and the round trip they are here to prove is the path, not the hue.
